name: io.github.FraiseHQ/fraise
title: Fraise
description: Memory database for AI agents: remember and recall over a running Fraise daemon, in FQL.

runtimeArguments.name: --add-host
runtimeArguments.description: Resolves host.docker.internal to the host on Linux too, where Docker Desktop is not there to do it.

packageArguments.description: Runs the stdio MCP bridge rather than the daemon the image starts by default.

packageArguments.name: -addr
packageArguments.description: URL of the running Fraise daemon the bridge forwards to. The daemon runs separately, like a database behind a connection URL: on the host (brew services start fraise, or systemctl --user start fraise), or as its own container with port 9876 published. Inside this container 127.0.0.1 is the bridge itself, so the default names the host.

environmentVariables.name: FRAISE_ADDR
environmentVariables.description: URL of the running Fraise daemon the server forwards to. The daemon runs separately, like a database behind a connection URL: on the host (brew services start fraise, or systemctl --user start fraise), or as its own container with port 9876 published.

environmentVariables.name: FRAISE_EMBEDDING_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: fastembed model each statement's text is embedded with, locally. A graph's first vector fixes its dimension, so a graph keeps the model it was first written with.

environmentVariables.name: FRAISE_NO_VECTORS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to send every statement on text alone.
